title: Chinese Steel Stockpiles Are Rising as Russian Coal Prices Fall
subtitle: With the effects of the Chinese mining accident fading, Far East coking coal and pulverised coal prices retreated while Chinese steel inventories climbed by a fifth.

source.name: Far East FOB coal price assessments and Chinese steel inventory data

data.label: Chinese steel stocks
data.annotation: Up to 9.4 million tons in June, weighing on future demand for imported coal.

data.label: Coking coal
data.annotation: 148 US dollars per ton after thirty days of decline.

supportingFacts.label: Further falls are expected as Australian output recovers and Chinese construction stays weak.
June mining fell 10% year over year, but the first half of 2026 still finished 1% above 2025.

metadata.keyFinding: Coking coal fell 7.5% while Chinese steel inventories rose 21%, pointing to further declines.
